lines.trans: We are sort of dating, and sort of not.
After all, we still have not slept together.
For you this kind of thing is familiar.
But Dima is in complete bewilderment right now.
I do not understand what to do at all.
She shies away from all of my friends.
And what do you need from me?
I decided to invite her out to dinner.
With handsome, smart, cultured people.
Lena is beautiful, smart, and cultured.
Unfortunately, nothing will work out for us.
Because I broke up with her.

examples.text: Нет, я всё решил! Мы с ней точно расстанемся.
examples.trans: No, I have decided everything! She and I will definitely break up.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'давно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Я с ней недавно расстался.
examples.trans: I recently broke up with her.

examples.text: Макс сказал это совершенно недавно и спокойно.
examples.trans: Max said this quite recently and calmly.
